# The Horse That Came Back Alone

*A patrol horse came back to the stables at night with an empty saddle. Its rider walked home safe, but the horse will not go near the road. Find where it bolted on the Thyme Banks and clear 30 downs boars there.*

## Objectives

2. Defeat 30 [Downs Boar](../monsters/downs_boar.md) in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
